name: Gemini
description: Google AI Mode as a chat model, in an Edge window lucode drives. No API key and no tokens: it uses the Google account signed in to that window.
author: lucode

conversations.title: AI Mode conversations
conversations.emptyText: None yet. Each conversation you have with Google AI Mode is saved here by its address.

settings.label: First message of each conversation
settings.help: Tells Gemini how to answer; its reply to it is not shown. Empty: the one that ships with the plugin.

settings.label: Hide the Edge window
settings.help: With it hidden, a human check from Google cannot be solved until you turn this off.

flowNodes.label: Ask Google AI Mode
flowNodes.description: Asks in a new conversation of its own, which closes afterwards. It waits its turn behind any other conversation. "answer" gives what it said, as text.

blueprints.name: Research new cards with Google AI Mode
blueprints.description: When a card is created, asks Google AI Mode about it and leaves the answer as a comment. The card's title and description go to Google.
